what: Across several screen heights of explanation sections, a round disc stays pinned to the screen, and the layers of video and photo inside the disc are tied straight to the scroll and crossfade in order. Of the original timeline total of 3.5 units, 1→2 runs at .5~1 and 2→3 at 1.5~2 (.5 unit, power1.out). After the last crossfade it rests for 1 unit, and at unit 3 the final layer (something like a guide cover) turns on, while the section background shifts from base color to accent color and the disc background from gray to deep accent together. A ”three-step explanation” where only the image inside the left circle changes as the right-hand text sections pass one screen at a time

options.hold: Pause from the last crossing’s end to the end overlap (cells), default 1
options.ease: Crossing curve, default power1.out — the original wrote Power4 in the first fromTo slot, but GSAP doesn’t read it, so the default curve applied
options.start · end: Pin range (ScrollTrigger), default top top · bottom bottom
options.narrow: At this width (px) and below, nothing is pinned and only the first layer stays, default 767 — on the original phone, each section has its own circle
options.--fx-from-bg · --fx-to-bg: Section background start and end (CSS variables), default var(--kf-surface) · var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-disc · --fx-disc-to: Panel background start·end, default var(--kf-bg) · accent 82% + text color
options.[data-fx-part=disc]: Sticking rounded panel — the parent must be the full section height and the panel sits in the first screen area inside it (centered if the parent is flex)
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Layers inside the panel (video, photo) — cross over in order
options.[data-fx-part=final]: (optional) the layer that turns on at the end — if absent, the last layer stays
